title: agent.json
description: The record of an agent, in its folder beside prompt.md. The author writes name and description, and may write files and packs. An agent a component ships holds only those: its agent.json names no harness, no model and no effort, and rbtv refuses a component whose shipped agent names one. In an installation, an rbtv agent's agent.json also holds harness, model and effort: rbtv agent add writes them from its --harness, --model and --effort flags when the file has none, and rbtv agent configure changes them. rbtv writes voice through rbtv agent configure, files and packs through rbtv agent add and remove, and the record of generated files. Programs read it, and the agent's own commands read it too.

name.description: The agent's name. It equals the agent folder's name.

description.description: One line that tells a caller when to choose this agent.

harness.description: The harness that runs the rbtv agent. Only in an installation. Checked against cast models list.

model.description: The model. Only in an installation. Checked against cast models list.

effort.description: The effort word that the model accepts. Only in an installation. Checked against cast models list.

voice.description: Optional voice, written by rbtv agent configure. Not checked.

avatar.description: Optional picture Ignite shows beside the agent's Slack posts: a Slack emoji such as :owl:, or a public https image URL. Written by rbtv agent configure --avatar.

external_name.description: Optional name people see, such as the Slack sender name, in place of the capitalized internal name. The internal name stays the folder name everywhere else. Written by rbtv agent configure --external-name.

opening.description: Optional, author-written. The first message of a headed launch of this agent that is given no task, such as a person opening it with spark: what the agent does before the person speaks. Absent or blank, the session opens with no first message. A headless launch never reads it.

listed.description: Optional, author-written, for an agent folder outside .rbtv/agents/. True makes cast list, spark list and rbtv agent list show the agent, and lets cast --agent and spark find it by name. Absent or false, the agent is found by its path only.

files.description: The files chosen on their own, as full ids <module>/<component>#<name>. A short name is accepted on input when it is unique in the source catalog.

packs.description: The names of packs enabled for this agent.

schema.description: The version of this record's format.

components.description: Each component that generated files for this agent, keyed by its id. Under a component, `selected` maps each installed file to its type (`method`) and its generated `files`. A file of type agent, installed as a harness-native sub-agent, also holds `sub_agent`: for each harness the file is written for, the `model` (cast's name for it), the `model_id` (the harness's own name for it) and the `effort`.

shared_files.description: Files shared by components through booked keys or fenced sections.

shared_claims.description: Which component owns each booked key or fenced section inside a shared file, as path::key.

guidance_basis.description: The folder instructions file the author writes: CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md.

guidance_excludes.description: Paths rbtv does not walk when it writes folder instructions copies.
